notes.title: November Update
notes.notes:
Roughing in more areas of the map, testing how the nature feels. 
 New snow-covered trees on a mountaintop.
 The river is back in, stages working. 

A lot of various small fixes.

notes.title: October Update Notes
notes.notes:
Testing out these patch notes...

 Flute added! play with keys: RTYUIOP. It's a prototype.
Sky fixed.
Icerafts are more robust and optimized.
The gameplay around inventory Items got improved and outline method changed.
Procedural animal tracks added (some locations only).
Throwing snowball now flies generally towards the target, even if the mouse trace misses.
